The '''Wall Basket''' is a [[furniture]] item that hangs on a wall.  It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] in the [[Secret Woods]] pond during any season (8% chance)<ref name="basketchance" />.  Multiple Wall Baskets may be obtained.
